通过 AI Toolkit 的管道对齐推理节点在 ComfyUI 中生成训练匹配的 FLUX.2 Klein 9B LoRA 输出。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外— 在本地镜像之前在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用— 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则很有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配— 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时— 您希望完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望— 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

FLUX.2 Klein 9B LoRA ComfyUI Inference 为您提供了一个可立即运行的 ComfyUI 图，用于在 FLUX.2 Klein 9B 上应用经过 AI Toolkit 训练的 LoRA，并具有管道级精度。 Flux2Klein9BPipeline 包装了 Klein 9B 推理管道 - Qwen3-8B 文本编码、流程匹配调度和内部适配器注入 - 因此 ComfyUI 生成的行为方式与 AI Toolkit 渲染训练预览的方式相同。适配器加载支持 models/loras 中的本地文件或直接 .safetensors URL，由 lora_path 和 lora_scale 控制。由于 Klein 9B 不是引导蒸馏，guiding_scale 直接影响输出质量；将其与您的训练样本配置相匹配可以避免预览不匹配的最常见原因。工作流程通过 SaveImage 输出标准图像，以便与训练进行直接并排比较 预览。

重要节点：

  • 加载管道

  • 保存图像

  • RC FLUX.2

Generate training-matched FLUX.2 Klein 9B LoRA outputs in ComfyUI through AI Toolkit's pipeline-aligned inference nodes.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning — you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises— run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout— useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON— the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense— you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations— First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

FLUX.2 Klein 9B LoRA ComfyUI Inference gives you a ready-to-run ComfyUI graph for applying AI Toolkit-trained LoRAs on FLUX.2 Klein 9B with pipeline-level accuracy. Flux2Klein9BPipeline wraps the Klein 9B inference pipeline-Qwen3-8B text encoding, flow-match scheduling, and internal adapter injection-so ComfyUI generation behaves the same way AI Toolkit renders training previews. Adapter loading supports local files in models/loras or direct .safetensors URLs, controlled by lora_path and lora_scale. Because Klein 9B is not guidance-distilled, guidance_scale directly shapes output quality; matching it to your training sample config avoids the most common source of preview mismatch. The workflow outputs standard images through SaveImage for straightforward side-by-side comparison with training previews.

Important nodes:

  • Load Pipeline

  • SaveImage

  • RC FLUX.2
